reels.caption:
@basilicasagradafamilia..After more than 140 years of construction, the moment the world has been waiting for is finally unfolding. The last structural elements are being placed, and the final tower pieces are rising into the Barcelona skyline.

What started in 1882 as a visionary project by Antoni Gaudí is now reaching its long-anticipated completion phase. The installation of the final spire elements marks not just the end of construction — but the fulfillment of a generational promise.

This isn't just about placing the last stone.
It's about finishing a story interrupted by time, war, funding challenges, and evolving technology. From hand-drawn plans to parametric modeling and digital fabrication — this basilica has lived through architectural history itself.

And now, the skyline of Barcelona is officially crowned.

A project that outlived its architect.
A construction site that became a global symbol.
A basilica that proves vision > time.

—
